title: TS-50 Implement the black-box acceptance smoke test
description: Found running the rehearsal (TS-39): conversation/bin/acceptance.ts runSmokeTest is a stub that prints 'Smoke test not yet implemented', although TS-4 closed. Implement it per the file's own header: speaking only HTTP (with the SigV4 client in conversation/src/acceptance/sigv4.ts and http-client.ts, plus the integration-test auth used by features/integration_test_auth.feature if the Function URL needs it; read conversation/src/auth and src/http to see exactly how a caller authenticates to a deployed ChatticusControlPlane Function URL) against a deployed environment: sign in or authenticate as the test principal, create a bot, create a channel, post a message, read the turn's SSE stream until the turn completes (a real model call: the deployed executor uses the dev OpenAI key), reload the channel and assert the bot's reply message is persisted and ordered after the user message, and finally steer a second post to the same bot while a turn runs if feasible. Record each check name in result.checks, throw clear typed errors, exit non-zero on failure, print the result as JSON. It must be testable without AWS: add a vitest that runs the smoke test against the in-process createApp front door with the scripted provider (see conversation/features-support for the FrontDoor and fakes) so the logic is verified before the live run. Mutation-check the vitest (break the reload ordering, the stream completion wait, and the persisted-reply check). Then run it live: AWS_PROFILE=chatticus-development CHATTICUS_DEVELOPMENT_BASE_URL=<ControlPlaneFunctionUrl of the ChatticusControlPlane stack> npx tsx bin/acceptance.ts --environment development (read-only AWS except through the app). Report the exact output; if the live run fails, report the failure and do NOT fix the production code in this ticket: stop and report the exact error (the orchestrator decides).
